notes.title: Released Date & DEMO
notes.content: [h1]Release Date Announcement[/h1][p]I’m happy to share that [i]BARABIZNA[/i] will officially release on [b]October 23, 2025[/b]![/p][p]Check out the brand-new official trailer and get a glimpse of the nightmare that awaits.[/p][previewyoutube="NwRjmB9Bx1U;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Try the Demo Now [/h1][p]Step inside a decaying home where every room hides both what you need—and what you fear.[/p][list][*][p]Each item you collect draws you deeper into the nightmare, twisting the rules and making survival harder.[/p][/*][*][p]With just [b]15 minutes of battery life[/b] to light your way, every second matters.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][p]In the demo, you’ll face the first floor of the house, where you must find [b]3 random items[/b] to escape.[/p][/*][/list][p]Will you gather what you need and make it out alive… or will the house claim you?[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861550/BARABIZNA_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445215/b84d5ba1c9e7952278f208efb52b5028f2149f0d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo coming on September 18.
notes.content: [h1][b]Barabizna Demo is coming very soon.[/b][/h1][p]On [b]September 18[/b], the doors to the old house will finally open. In the [i]BARABIZNA[/i] demo, you’ll step into a decaying home where every room hides an object you need and something that doesn’t want you to find them.[/p][p]Each item you collect draws you deeper into the nightmare, twisting the rules and making survival harder with every step. With only 15 minutes of light to guide you, every second counts.[/p][p]Will you gather everything you need and escape… or will the house claim you?[/p][p][b]The demo arrives September 18 [/b]and until then, check out the [b]new teaser trailer[/b] for a glimpse of what awaits for you.[/p][previewyoutube="4hTx__eM_Tw;full"][/previewyoutube]
